issue.title: Policy evaluation order
issue.author: ann
issue.body: In which order are policies evaluated?

comments.author: bob
comments.body:
Policies are evaluated in declaration order, which surprised several users who expected priority order.

The relevant loop is here: https://github.com/example/project/blob/0a1b2c3d/src/scheduler/policy.py#L42-L57 and it has not changed since the rewrite.

We decided to keep declaration order because changing it would silently alter existing deployments.
